value.text: Got the Preschool Sports and Games page for Maya. It runs Wednesdays at 10:30 AM, ages 3 to 5, so it fits her. Price is $280.60, or $290.60 for non-residents, course code 00028147. Nothing is booked yet. Residents open Sep 8, and the public opens Tuesday, September 15 at 10:30 a.m. The page disagrees with the date I had (Monday, September 14 at 10:30 a.m.), so I'm going by the page. There's also a registration form on the page I can't see, so leave some time to fill it in before the window opens.
